Homeowner calendars

Give homeowners a read-only calendar of their own build. Their house only — never your other jobs. Crews show by trade, not by name ("Flooring crew at the house Tue–Thu"), and your notes to crews stay private. Homeowners who can see the week ahead call and text far less.
